+class Arc:
+    """Polyline parameterized by true arclength in metres, including tangent extrapolation."""
+    def __init__(self, points):
+        p = np.asarray([xy_px(*q) for q in points], dtype=np.float64)
+        # remove nearly duplicate adjacent waypoints
+        keep = [0]
+        for i in range(1, len(p)):
+            if np.linalg.norm(p[i] - p[keep[-1]]) > 1e-8:
+                keep.append(i)
+        self.p = p[keep]
+        self.seg = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(self.p, axis=0), axis=1)
+        self.cum = np.concatenate([[0.], np.cumsum(self.seg)])
+        self.length = float(self.cum[-1])
+
+    def at(self, d: float) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+        if d < 0:
+            tang = self.tangent(0.)
+            return self.p[0] + d * tang, tang
+        if d >= self.length:
+            tang = self.tangent(self.length)
+            return self.p[-1] + (d - self.length) * tang, tang
+        j = int(np.searchsorted(self.cum, d, side='right') - 1)
+        t = (d - self.cum[j]) / self.seg[j]
+        tang = (self.p[j + 1] - self.p[j]) / self.seg[j]
+        return self.p[j] * (1 - t) + self.p[j + 1] * t, tang

+    def tangent(self, d: float) -> np.ndarray:
+        if d <= 0:
+            return (self.p[1] - self.p[0]) / self.seg[0]
+        if d >= self.length:
+            return (self.p[-1] - self.p[-2]) / self.seg[-1]

+    return w, d, o

+def profile(stroke: dict, d: float, length: float) -> float:
+    maxp = stroke['p'] / 1000.
+    if 'dot' in stroke['name'] or 'water_1' in stroke['name'] or 'water_2' in stroke['name'] or 'final_dot' in stroke['name']:
+        # Slightly rounded dots, broad enough to match the teardrop terminals.
+        return maxp
+    ramp = min(0.004, length * 0.22)
+    start = min(maxp, .0010)
+    end = min(maxp, .0008)
+    if ramp > 0 and d < ramp:
+        t = d / ramp
+        return start * (1 - t) + maxp * t
+    if ramp > 0 and d > length - ramp:
+        t = (d - (length - ramp)) / ramp
+        return maxp * (1 - t) + end * t

+    ans = s.primitives()['move_tip'](np.asarray(pos, float), speed=speed, settle=settle)

+

+    orient_start, _ = arc.at(max(0., lead0 - 0.006))
+    hover = 0.055

+    drive_tip(s, [*orient_start, 0.027], speed=0.08)

+    drive_tip(s, [*start, PAPER_Z - p0], speed=0.018, settle=2)

+    ds = speed / 20.

        current_actions = warped
    actions = best_actions
    status = s.replay(actions)
